source_title: Orders of October 1, 2025: rates for credit accident and health insurance for 2026
rate_table_note: Single premium rates are from the consumer credit transactions order, page 2 (https://doi.sc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15111/Order-No-2025-003-Rates-for-Credit-Accident-and-Health-Insurance-in-South-Carolina); the 3-day retroactive rate is from the Consumer Finance Law order, page 2 (https://doi.sc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15112/Order-No-2025-004-Rates-for-3-day-Retro-Credit-Accident-and-Health-Insurance-in-South-Carolins). The first file is named Order No. 2025-003 but the order is headed Number 2025-004, the same number as the 3-day order. Old rates not recorded: the orders for 2025 (Order Numbers 2024-04 and 2024-06) are scanned images with no text and were not imported.
summary: South Carolina's Director of Insurance set the credit accident and health prima facie rates for 2026 by orders dated October 1, 2025, after tentative rates in Bulletin 2025-06 (August 11, 2025) drew no hearing request. Single premium rates per $100 of initial indebtedness for consumer credit transactions; the 3-day retroactive rate for Consumer Finance Law loans fell 15%. Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month rates.
legal_basis: 25A S.C. Code Ann. Reg. 69-11.1; S.C. Code Ann. § 37-1-101 et seq.

plan: 3-day retroactive, loans under the Consumer Finance Law (1966 Act No. 988)
basis: per year per $5.00 unit of monthly indemnity

source_title: Orders of November 2, 2026: rates for credit accident and health insurance for 2027 (Order Numbers 2026-04 and 2026-05)
rate_table_note: Single premium rates are from Order Number 2026-04, page 2 (https://doi.sc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15548/Order-Number-2026-04--Rates-for-Credit-Accident-and-Health-Ins-in-SC-in-Conjuction-with-Consumer-Credit-Transactions); the 3-day retroactive rate is from Order Number 2026-05 (https://doi.sc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15549/Order-Number-2026-05-Rates-for-3-Day-Retro-Credit-Accident-and-Health-Ins-in-SC-in-Conjuction-with-Loans). Order 2026-04's opening paragraph says rates 'for use during 2026', but its table and findings are for 2027. Old rates are from the orders of October 1, 2025 (https://doi.sc.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15111/Order-No-2025-003-Rates-for-Credit-Accident-and-Health-Insurance-in-South-Carolina).
summary: South Carolina's Director of Insurance set the credit accident and health prima facie rates for 2027 by Orders 2026-04 and 2026-05 dated November 2, 2026, after tentative rates in Bulletins 2026-03 and 2026-04 (September 10, 2026) drew no hearing request. Single premium rates per $100 of initial indebtedness fall about 15%; the 3-day retroactive rate for Consumer Finance Law loans falls from $0.17 to $0.14 (the order cites a 15% reduction). Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month rates.
legal_basis: 25A S.C. Code Ann. Reg. 69-11.1; S.C. Code Ann. § 37-1-101 et seq.

plan: 3-day retroactive, loans under the Consumer Finance Law (1966 Act No. 988)
basis: per year per $5.00 unit of monthly indemnity
